notes: Level 0 (EF-000 to EF-003) is four parallel evidence gates and must complete before EF-010 locks the entry.
EF-010 may reverse the recommended winner. That is the node's purpose, not a failure.
EF-100 is the only node with an irreversible external effect and is gated on the independent review EF-090, per durability ordering.
EF-040 is the highest-variance node. Its failure triggers the fallback in FULL_REPORT.md section 11 rather than a retry.

Levels were corrected after validation: EF-030 and EF-050 were initially placed in the same level as dependencies EF-020 and EF-040. A dependency level is not an executable wave (DAG runbook lesson 4).

risk_gates.EF-010: Do not build any deliverable before the entry is locked against the real rubric.
risk_gates.EF-040: No named design partner after 30 days means the entry loses its regional anchor. Re-run EF-010 with CryoAssay rather than pitching an unanchored entry.
risk_gates.EF-090: No submission may bypass independent review, including under deadline pressure.
risk_gates.EF-100: Irreversible. Requires EF-020 eligibility resolved and zero open critical findings.
